text:
SIPALG::hairpin_default
Description
This iRules command gets or sets the value of hairpin flag for the current connection.
Syntax
SIPALG
::
hairpin_default
[
detect
|
disable
|
enable
]
SIPALG::hairpin_default
Returns the value of the hairpin flag for the current message.
SIPALG::hairpin_default <detect | disable | enable>
Returns ‘detect’, ‘disable’, or ‘enable’
Examples
when
SIP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"default hairpin mode [SIPALG::hairpin_default]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED, SERVER_CONNECTED, SIP_REQUEST, SIP_REQUEST_SEND, SIP_RESPONSE, SIP_RESPONSE_SEND
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0
